back.es: What are you (informal) going to do tomorrow?
back.example: What are you going to do tomorrow? I'm going to work.

note: The informal hint is needed because it rules out the usted version ¿Qué va a hacer mañana?, and the future-tense ¿Qué harás mañana? is less common in speech, so the ir a + infinitive answer is the natural one to expect.
